body:
Updates since [v0.4.9](https://github.com/apstndb/spanemuboost/releases/tag/v0.4.9). Cloud Spanner Emulator remains the default backend. Spanner Omni integration remains experimental.

## Changed

- Update the default Cloud Spanner Emulator image from 1.5.58 to [1.5.59](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/cloud-spanner-emulator/releases/tag/v1.5.59). Upstream adds expression indexes, queues, multi-key vector indexes, JSON comparison and JSON subfield DML, and fixes clock drift and memory retention after dropping databases.
- Update the default Omni Developer image from 2026.r2.1-beta in v0.4.9 (2026.r4-lts in alpha.1) to [2026.r5](https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner-omni/release-notes#October_29_2026). This upstream release includes managed Spanner changes through October 27, 2026.
- Automatically select Omni startup arguments from the image tag: tags identifying 2026.r1 through r3 use flagless start-single-server, while other references use --listen-addresses=0.0.0.0 for forwarded ports. Preserve the native entrypoint and explicit custom commands.
- Add CLI --image IMAGE and --image=IMAGE support for choosing a runtime image.

## Compatibility

- No public API was removed and the Go requirement remains 1.25. Existing runtime images can still be selected using WithContainerImage or the CLI image flag.
- Digest-only and unrecognized Omni image tags use the listen flag. Name-based startup selection does not establish runtime compatibility for arbitrary images; existing container customizers can supply explicit commands.
- This release validates unauthenticated, single-server Developer deployments with the existing Spanner Go SDK v1.82.0. It does not add authenticated deployments or promise Omni feature parity.

Merged changes: [#87](https://github.com/apstndb/spanemuboost/pull/87), [#88](https://github.com/apstndb/spanemuboost/pull/88).

## Validation

- Source: `62a784a09d51c85c10c648e49a4b5bd99cb2aba0`, byte-identical to the tested update PR.
- Local race suite (62.914s), lint v2.12.2 (0 issues), build, startup regression test and diff check passed.
- Local Docker Omni smoke passed (270.710s), including r2.1/r3 compatibility tests and r5 startup, clients, database override and rollback.
- Post-merge [Go CI](https://github.com/apstndb/spanemuboost/actions/runs/42401760195) passed build-and-test, Docker Omni smoke, and rootless Podman Emulator/Omni smoke. [Lint CI](https://github.com/apstndb/spanemuboost/actions/runs/42401760190) passed on the same source.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/apstndb/spanemuboost/compare/v0.4.9...v0.4.10

## Published alpha verification

The published [v0.4.10-alpha.2](https://github.com/apstndb/spanemuboost/releases/tag/v0.4.10-alpha.2) module was fetched from GitHub into a separate Go module without a local replace. Both default backends passed table creation, mutation, row read, image provenance assertions, idempotent Close, and absence of leftover test containers on linux/arm64 Docker. The final version uses the identical source commit. Both Docker and rootless Podman smoke suites also passed in amd64 hosted CI.
